reason: It's a brand-new bottle with no reviews I can read, and a creator code isn't proof. I'm not putting $68 and a recurring filter subscription on an unknown brand when a plastic bottle now and then costs me a couple of dollars.
objection: Zero track record plus a subscription I'll probably forget to cancel. I have no way to know if the filter actually does anything or if the bottle leaks.
would_change_my_mind: Hundreds of verified reviews and independent filter test results, plus being able to buy the bottle and filters one-off without signing up for a plan.
